correctness.rationale: Full proof separates the scalar-valued norm translation case from the quotient-surjective linear case. For odd characteristic each quadratic restriction has 1 singleton and (q-1)/2 doubles; for even characteristic nondegeneracy of the trace pairing yields exactly one bijective line and q-1 double lines. Their fiber totals sum to q², and the packaged finite verifier exhausts 3123 linear operators across p=2,3,5,7.
